name: Rank field
description: Converts a series of selected text entry fields on a survey page into a drag-and-drop rank order field. Rank order is then stored in each field's value.

action-tags.description:
Converts a series of selected text entry fields on a survey page into a drag-and-drop rank order field. Rank order is then stored in each field's value. Must be placed on a descriptive text field. Takes a list of fields to be converted to rankable options using the simplified syntax @RANK=field1,field2,field3,field4,field5.

Advanced usage: Parameter is a JSON object that takes options fields: a comma-separated list of text input fields to rank, min: minimum number of fields to include in ranking (optional), max: maximum number of fields to include in ranking (optional), and message: where false suppresses the default message about how many items need to be ranked (optional; default = true).

Full example: @RANK={"fields":"field1,field2,field3,field4,field5","min":2,"max":5,"message":false}.
